description: This Java source file defines an immutable class 'ImmutableResource' implementing the 'Resource' interface. It provides methods for creating resource instances from JSON data, accessing resource properties, and converting to JSON. The class manages resource keys and permissions within a policy model, with focus on JSON serialization/deserialization and resource identification.

classes.name: ImmutableResource
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the Resource interface, representing a resource with a key and permissions, with JSON serialization/deserialization capabilities.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableResource instance from a ResourceKey and a JsonValue containing permissions.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableResource instance from a ResourceKey and EffectedPermissions.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableResource instance from a JsonObject, extracting resource key and permissions.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the resource type from the resource key.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the resource path as a JsonPointer.

methods.name: getFullQualifiedPath
methods.description: Returns the full qualified path of the resource as a string.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the resource to a JsonObject, applying a schema version and predicate filter.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
